```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import create_proxy

async def main():
    # Assuming backend_server is your existing FastMCP server instance in memory
    # Replace this with your actual backend server variable
    backend_server = None  # Placeholder - use your actual backend instance
    
    if backend_server is None:
        raise ValueError("Backend server instance not provided")
    
    # Create a transparent proxy that forwards all requests to the backend
    proxy = create_proxy(backend_server, name="FastMCP Proxy")
    
    # Run the proxy server using stdio transport
    await proxy.run_stdio_async()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```
